fp16.x_c.rule: A words (1, 1), B words (lo, hi) (1, -1), k-group-0 (2, 2) x (4, 4): each micro-op's products cancel, C = +16 n, no sign moves

fp16.x_s.rule: x_c with A s (1, 1), B t (1, -1), s and t random at k-group>=1 (default_rng(10600)): the products cancel inside each micro-op, C = +16 n, nonzero aligned operands, both operands' signs moving

fp16.z_ss.rule: E92's fp16.s_abs's B, A at k-group>=1 at random among (-0, -0), (+0, -0), (-0, +0) (default_rng(10600)), the seed of c_abs: zero products, C = n 2^31, both operands' signs moving, both eff_sub flipping independently
